Hypothesis 1 — Supervisor briefing

NS-IBTS Q1 (1985–2015) · EEoS haul-level biomass

2026-06-15

Briefing pack for supervisor discussion. Pipeline outputs refreshed on 2026-06-15; analysis uses frozen data (no dataset updates). See pipeline/README.md for run order.

Part A — Methods (notes)

A1. Data and analysis sample

  • Survey: NS-IBTS Quarter 1, 1985–2015
  • Observed biomass (B_obs): FishGlob sum(wgt) × 1000 → grams per haul (pipeline/build_eeos_predictions.R)
  • State variables (S, N, E): DATRAS HL length bins + FishBase LW lookup (pipeline/build_datras_state_variables.R)
  • Join: Inner join FishGlob ↔︎ DATRAS on 6-field haul key (Survey, Year, Quarter, Country, Ship, HaulNo)
  • Analysis panel: 12,069 hauls — 12117 joined → 48 excluded by EEoS filters → 12069 with predictions
  • Filter exclusions: B_obs > 0, S ≥ 2, E > N, finite normalised E (44 zero-biomass FishGlob hauls, mostly 1991; 4 single-species hauls)
  • LW gaps: Individuals in bins without usable FishBase a/b parameters are dropped from S, N, E (32 MISSING-fallback taxa in lookup; not imputed)

A2. E calculation — key decisions

Step Decision
Taxa Fish only; cephalopods, crustaceans, bivalves excluded by AphiaID (pipeline/R/datras_constants.R)
Length units LngtCode → cm midpoints (codes 0, 1, 5, .) (pipeline/R/datras_hl_helpers.R)
Mass W(g) = a·L(cm)^b from frozen outputs/fishbase_lw_lookup_v2.csv (TL-type hierarchy, built offline)
LW gaps Bins with missing/non-finite a/b or mass dropped before aggregation
N sum(HLNoAtLngt × SubFactor) over LW-valid bins (same rows as E)
S n_distinct(AphiaID) over same bins (= n_species_with_lw)
E_raw sum(N_at_bin × mass^0.75)
m_min Mass of smallest length bin in haul (not species mean length)
E (EEoS input) E = E_raw / m_min^0.75 so minimum individual metabolic rate = 1

A3. EEoS prediction at haul level

  • Per haul: S, N, E (normalised) → Python biomass.biomass() via reticulate (equation_of_state/biomass.py)
  • Output: dimensionless B_pred_norm; B_pred = B_pred_norm × m_min (grams)
  • Primary residual: log(B_obs) − log(B_pred) (negative ⇒ EEoS overpredicts catch biomass)
  • Primary R²: log_r2() = 1 − SS_res/SS_tot (can be negative); not cor(log B)²

A4. Correlative benchmark and null model

ln(E) reference (Harte et al. 2022):

  • lm(log(B_obs) ~ log(E)) on same hauls, same normalised E as EEoS (pipeline/run_h1_lne_reference.R)
  • Harte criterion: EEoS unexplained SS should be < ½ ln(E) SS

B-only null (S/N/E not shuffled — breaks EEoS constraints):

  • Fixed B_pred from observed (S, N, E); randomise B_obs only (pipeline/run_h1_null_model.R)
  • log(B_obs) is concentrated (IQR/range = 0.12, peak ratio = 4.96, excess kurtosis = 1.02). Empirical resampling would largely recreate the observed biomass scale; primary null uses a uniform draw on the central 95% of log(B_obs).
  • Primary null: uniform on central 95% of log(B_obs) (uniform_log_b_95; 999 permutations, seed 42)
  • Robustness null: permute observed B_obs across hauls (b_shuffle)
